action: As reported, Woolworths urges customers who see e-gift card transactions they do not recognise to contact its Gift Card Support team or report them through the Everyday Gifting website.
date_note: The Cyber Express page, dated 16 November, relays an ABC News report it says was published that Monday; no earlier day is given.

evidence.quote: Shoppers have reported losses of up to $500, with some discovering their gift cards had been completely emptied

exec: Gift card fraud at Woolworths with no stated cause; the company is reimbursing affected customers with replacement cards.
plain: Dozens of Woolworths shoppers found their digital gift cards had been spent by someone else. Woolworths apologised and is issuing replacement cards; the reports do not say what caused it.
summary: The Cyber Express, relaying an ABC News investigation, reported dozens of customers whose digital WISH gift cards were emptied by transactions they did not make, with losses of up to $500. Woolworths apologised and, Sunrise reported on November 17, has begun issuing replacement gift cards so affected customers are fully reimbursed. Neither report says how card details were obtained or whether a cyberattack occurred; The Cyber Express says nothing links it to the Coles incident.
title: Woolworths acknowledges issue after customers report drained digital gift cards

validation.note: The Cyber Express (relaying ABC News) and The Nightly (republishing Sunrise, 17 Nov) each report the drained cards and quote Woolworths' acknowledgement; The Nightly also quotes its apology and the replacement cards. Neither gives a cause.

review.note: attribution: dozens/ABC and no-Coles-link now said as relayed by The Cyber Express; date_note and source published day added
